subject: Re: Kickoff: MolDQN lead-optimization pilot — decisions for the pilot report
body:
Team,

Decisions for the Jul 27 close:

1) Pilot report recommends go for a Q4 engagement with Partner A only. Partner B gets the "peripheral optimization only" framing in Wei's words, verbatim, plus an explicit note that aromatic-core edits need MDP work we have not scheduled.
2) The edit-trajectory audit log becomes a headline feature, not an internal artifact — Giannis, package the trajectory viewer for the partner readout. It's the strongest trust differentiator we have.
3) Budget: we're tracking to the B-58 earmark; Idris, looping you in since the Q4 engagement would need a fresh line — the Q3 earmark doesn't roll over.
4) Scope cut confirmed: multi-property optimization stays out of the pilot.

Readout with both partners the week of Jul 20. Nice work getting the science and the honesty into the same document.

Ximena
